description: This Java class 'CatalogWorker' provides utility methods for managing product catalogs within the OFBiz framework. It includes functions to retrieve catalog IDs, names, categories, and configuration flags, often based on request/session context or database queries.

classes.name: CatalogWorker
classes.description: Utility class for catalog-related operations in OFBiz, including retrieval of catalog IDs, names, categories, and configuration flags based on request/session context or database queries.

methods.name: getWebSiteId
methods.description: Deprecated method to get website ID from request, delegates to WebSiteWorker.

methods.name: getWebSite
methods.description: Deprecated method to get website details from request, delegates to WebSiteWorker.

methods.name: getAllCatalogIds
methods.description: Retrieves all catalog IDs from the database, ordered by catalog name.

methods.name: getStoreCatalogs
methods.description: Gets catalogs associated with a product store, based on request or delegator and store ID.

methods.name: getPartyCatalogs
methods.description: Gets catalogs associated with a party (user), based on session or delegator and party ID.

methods.name: getProdCatalogCategories
methods.description: Retrieves categories for a given product catalog and category type.

methods.name: getCurrentCatalogId
methods.description: Determines the current catalog ID from request parameters, session, or defaults to the first available catalog.

methods.name: getCatalogIdsAvailable
methods.description: Returns list of catalog IDs available based on party and store catalogs.

methods.name: getCatalogName
methods.description: Fetches the name of a catalog given its ID.

methods.name: getContentPathPrefix
methods.description: Gets the content path prefix for the current catalog.

methods.name: getTemplatePathPrefix
methods.description: Gets the template path prefix for the current catalog.

methods.name: getProdCatalog
methods.description: Retrieves the catalog entity for the current or specified catalog ID.

methods.name: getProdCatalogCategoryId
methods.description: Gets a specific category ID within a catalog based on category type.

methods.name: getCatalogTopCategoryId
methods.description: Gets the top-level browse category ID for a catalog.

methods.name: getCatalogSearchCategoryId
methods.description: Gets the search category ID for a catalog.

methods.name: getCatalogViewAllowCategoryId
methods.description: Gets the category ID that allows viewing all items in a catalog.

methods.name: getCatalogPurchaseAllowCategoryId
methods.description: Gets the category ID that allows purchase in a catalog.

methods.name: getCatalogPromotionsCategoryId
methods.description: Gets the promotions category ID for a catalog.

methods.name: getCatalogQuickaddUse
methods.description: Checks if quick add is enabled for a catalog.

methods.name: getCatalogQuickaddCategoryPrimary
methods.description: Gets the primary quick add category ID for a catalog.

methods.name: getCatalogQuickaddCategories
methods.description: Gets list of quick add category IDs for a catalog.

methods.name: getCatalogTopEbayCategoryId
methods.description: Gets the eBay root category ID for a catalog.
